items.name: formatters
items.title: Formatters
items.description: Locale-aware Intl-backed formatters (currency, date, datetime, relative time, number, percent, bytes) plus truncate and initials helpers. One place for every consistent string format in the app.

items.name: env-validator
items.title: Env validator (Zod)
items.description: Zod-validated server + client env loader. Fails fast at boot if anything required is missing or malformed. Import `env` everywhere instead of touching process.env directly.
